bg8jsi.q: Supplementary panel B shown indicates the number of lanes the road has
bg8jsi.why: Panel B only gives the number of hairpin bends (3) ahead; it has nothing to do with lanes, vehicles, overpasses, junctions or side roads.

tjre01.q: Supplementary panel B shown indicates how many vehicles can drive through the bend at the same time
tjre01.why: Panel B only gives the number of hairpin bends (3) ahead; it has nothing to do with lanes, vehicles, overpasses, junctions or side roads.

1oa4j1h.q: Supplementary panel B shown indicates how many kilometres remain until an overpass that allows a U-turn
1oa4j1h.why: Panel B only gives the number of hairpin bends (3) ahead; it has nothing to do with lanes, vehicles, overpasses, junctions or side roads.

110stnh.q: Supplementary panel B shown indicates the number of motorway junctions
110stnh.why: Panel B only gives the number of hairpin bends (3) ahead; it has nothing to do with lanes, vehicles, overpasses, junctions or side roads.

17w0xkd.q: The presence of either of the two supplementary panels shown indicates an intersection with a road from which lorries coming from a landfill enter
17w0xkd.why: The panels only indicate nearby hairpin bends, not a junction with a road feeding in lorries.

suwo2c.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the NO PARKING sign, indicates that parking is prohibited only during certain hours of the days indicated
suwo2c.why: Under the no-parking sign, the panel limits the ban to the hours shown on the days shown, for street cleaning.

1azrxcm.q: The supplementary panel shown is placed on stretches of road where street cleaning with road sweepers is carried out
1azrxcm.why: The road-sweeper panel is used where street cleaning is carried out, banning parking at the times shown.

15qdcvq.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the days and hours when street cleaning with road sweepers is carried out
15qdcvq.why: The panel gives the days (Monday to Friday) and hours (21:00-4:00) of street cleaning by road sweepers.

vvofzs.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the NO PARKING sign, indicates that parking is prohibited only during some hours of the days indicated
vvofzs.why: Under the no-parking sign, the panel limits the ban to the days and hours shown, for street cleaning.

khmczk.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the time for depositing rubbish
khmczk.why: The road-sweeper panel only gives the days and hours of street cleaning, when parking is banned; it does not concern rubbish, car washes or right of way.

7uo4qq.q: The supplementary panel shown indicates the opening days of car washes
7uo4qq.why: The road-sweeper panel only gives the days and hours of street cleaning, when parking is banned; it does not concern rubbish, car washes or right of way.

ufwrql.q: The supplementary panel shown requires you to give way to lorries
ufwrql.why: The road-sweeper panel only gives the days and hours of street cleaning, when parking is banned; it does not concern rubbish, car washes or right of way.

1hrb9gb.q: The supplementary panel shown, placed under the NO PARKING sign, indicates that the vehicles depicted may not park
1hrb9gb.why: The vehicle depicted is the street sweeper doing the cleaning; the panel bans parking for everyone at the times shown.

12y9o0o.q: The supplementary panels shown are placed under right-of-way signs
12y9o0o.why: The junction-diagram panels are placed under right-of-way (diritto di precedenza) signs.

ptohj6.q: The supplementary panels shown indicate an intersection, distinguishing the main road from the side roads
ptohj6.why: The diagram shows the junction, with the main road (thick line) distinguished from the side roads (thin lines).

ahneke.q: The supplementary panels shown, placed near an intersection, indicate the course of the main road
ahneke.why: Near a junction, the panels show the course of the main road relative to the side roads.

1u3nvvg.q: The supplementary panels shown may be found under the INTERSECTION WITH RIGHT OF WAY sign
1u3nvvg.why: These panels complement the intersection-with-right-of-way sign by showing the main road.

bnk8yd.q: Panels (B) and (C) shown indicate a dangerous bend
bnk8yd.why: The panels only show the junction layout, with the main road as a thick line; they do not indicate bends, parking, motorways, underpasses or closures.

epvmu2.q: The supplementary panels shown indicate how to leave the vehicle parked
epvmu2.why: The panels only show the junction layout, with the main road as a thick line; they do not indicate bends, parking, motorways, underpasses or closures.

1hy2i8b.q: The supplementary panels shown are also placed on motorways
1hy2i8b.why: Motorways have no at-grade intersections, so these junction panels are not placed there.

8hidtg.q: The supplementary panels shown indicate dead-end roads
8hidtg.why: The panels only show the junction layout, with the main road as a thick line; they do not indicate bends, parking, motorways, underpasses or closures.

vejl99.q: The supplementary panels shown indicate the presence of underpasses
vejl99.why: The panels only show the junction layout, with the main road as a thick line; they do not indicate bends, parking, motorways, underpasses or closures.

se5afj.q: The supplementary panels shown indicate that the intersecting roads are temporarily closed
se5afj.why: The panels only show the junction layout, with the main road as a thick line; they do not indicate bends, parking, motorways, underpasses or closures.

113bytr.q: The sign shown allows access only to buses
113bytr.why: The no-entry sign with the 'eccetto' (except) buses panel allows access only to buses.

1qgsepy.q: The sign shown indicates that all vehicles except buses may park
1qgsepy.why: The parking sign with the 'except buses' panel allows all vehicles except buses to park.

1x6bb3d.q: The supplementary panel shown can be combined with a mandatory sign
1x6bb3d.why: The 'except buses' panel can supplement prohibition and mandatory signs, excluding buses from the rule.

1gj5iol.q: The supplementary panel shown can be combined with a prohibition sign
1gj5iol.why: The 'except buses' panel can supplement prohibition and mandatory signs, excluding buses from the rule.

ojinw.q: The sign shown prohibits access to buses
ojinw.why: The 'except buses' panel exempts buses from the ban: only they may enter.

5nbd1v.q: The sign shown prohibits transit to buses
5nbd1v.why: The 'except buses' panel exempts buses from the ban: only they may pass.

guonau.q: The supplementary panel shown can be found on its own
guonau.why: A supplementary panel is never alone: it always sits under another sign that it completes.

1qmifjb.q: The supplementary panel shown applies only to urban buses
1qmifjb.why: The 'except' panel with a bus applies to buses in general, not only urban ones.
